title: PriceCalculatedEventV2
description: Published when a price calculation completes using the v2 fixed-cost allocation model.

messageName.description: The canonical v2 pricing event name.

messageVersion.description: The fixed semantic version of this additive pricing contract.

publishedBy.description: The service that publishes calculated prices.

consumedBy.description: The intended consumers; empty until a v2 consumer is implemented.

payload.description: The complete v2 pricing calculation result.

pricingAuditId.description: Unique identifier for the pricing audit record.

quotationId.description: Quotation identifier when the price is linked to a quotation.

fileId.description: Unique identifier for the priced file.

materialId.description: Material used for the pricing calculation.

inputVolumeCm3.description: Part volume in cubic centimetres used as input.

inputSupportVolumeCm3.description: Support material volume in cubic centimetres.

inputSurfaceAreaCm2.description: Surface area in square centimetres used as input.

strategy.description: Pricing strategy used for the calculation.

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence level of the price calculation from zero to one.

pricingConfigurationId.description: Pricing configuration record used for the calculation.

breakdown.description: Detailed cost breakdown with explicit fixed-cost allocation.

materialCost.description: Per-unit raw material cost in baseCurrency before margin.

supportCost.description: Per-unit support material cost in baseCurrency before margin.

machineTimeCost.description: Per-unit machine time cost in baseCurrency before margin.

setupCost.description: One-time setup cost in baseCurrency, applied once to the priced line before margin.

variableDfmSurcharge.description: Per-unit variable DFM surcharge in baseCurrency before margin, excluding fixedDfmSurcharge.

fixedDfmSurcharge.description: One-time setup-derived DFM surcharge in baseCurrency, applied once to the priced line before margin.

complexitySurcharge.description: Per-unit complexity surcharge in baseCurrency before margin, excluding both DFM components.

subtotalBeforeMargin.description: Full THB line subtotal before margin: ((materialCost + supportCost + machineTimeCost + variableDfmSurcharge + complexitySurcharge) * quantity) + setupCost + fixedDfmSurcharge.

marginAmount.description: Full THB line margin before volume discount: subtotalBeforeMargin * (marginMultiplier - 1).

marginMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied separately to the per-unit variable total and the one-time fixed line total.

volumeDiscountPercent.description: Percentage discount applied only to the margined per-unit variable components.

leadTimeMultiplier.description: Lead-time multiplier applied to both the discounted variable line total and the margined one-time fixed line total.

toleranceMultiplier.description: Tolerance multiplier applied to both the discounted variable line total and the margined one-time fixed line total.

minimumOrderPriceFloorThb.description: Minimum THB line total applied after quantity and the one-time fixed line cost, before exchangeRate.

exchangeRate.description: Multiplicative rate from baseCurrency to the payload currency, applied after the THB minimum floor.

baseCurrency.description: ISO 4217 base currency for all breakdown inputs; fixed to THB.

totalPrice.description: Final line total in the payload currency after margin, variable-only discount, quantity, one-time fixed costs, lead-time and tolerance multipliers, THB floor, and exchangeRate.

calculatedAt.description: Timestamp when the price was calculated.

storagePath.description: Storage path used as a frontend join key.

estimatedLeadTimeDays.description: Estimated production and shipping lead time in days.
